sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Your defect rate was 2376 ppm in 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).
Could you confirm ppm commitment of at most 1500?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Hello,
many thanks, good to have your reply!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
Please let me explain.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
We know our defect rate was a bit high recently, but we are fixing it, so we can agree to 1500 ppm like you asked (300 is too low for now).
I can't share our internal cost breakdown, company policy, you know how it is.
With the 1500 ppm, I can drop the price to 46.00 EUR. Let's make a deal.
Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. What we really need is for you to pay faster, since your payments have been coming in late. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

I can do 46.00 EUR for the 300 ppm you want. So, our offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
